title: Technical Recruiter
jobDescription:
Job Description : We are looking for an experienced IT Recruiter with 3+ years of experience in IT recruitment to join our team. As an IT Recruiter, you will be responsible for sourcing, attracting, and hiring top IT talent for our organization. You will play a key role in writing and posting technical job descriptions, identifying potential candidates on niche platforms, and ensuring a smooth hiring process. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Write and post detailed and technical job descriptions to attract qualified candidates.
- Source potential candidates using various platforms, including niche job boards, social media, and networking events.
- Conduct pre-screening calls to evaluate applicants' technical skills, experience, and cultural fit.
- Keep yourself updated with the latest technological trends and products to understand and assess candidates' technical expertise.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to source and identify candidates for niche technical roles.
- Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail. If you are passionate about recruitment and technology, and have a keen eye for talent, we would love to hear from you!
